title: Airboy #30 Eclipse Comics 1987 Bi-Weekly Paul Randall Cover
conditionDescription: Light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
Airboy #30 (September 1987), Eclipse Comics - bi-weekly. Paul Randall cover. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Scout #24 ad by Timothy Truman.

Condition: light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
